The connected character will: Continuously restore HP based on Dori's Max HP. Continuously regenerate Energy. Be affected by Electro. When the connector between the Jinni and the character touches opponents, it will deal one instance of Electro DMG to them. Only one Jinni can exist at one time. The Healing and Energy restoration effects occur every seconds. Connector DMG will snapshot Dori's stats on cast and will not be affected by changes in her stats that occur afterwards.
